ValidationRule.description: Require Property City, State, Zip on new MDU and Business ROE Opportunity creation.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR(RecordType.DeveloperName = 'MDU', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Business_ROE'), OR( AND(ISNEW(), OR(ISBLANK(Property_City__c), ISBLANK(Property_State__c), ISBLANK(Property_Zip__c))), AND(ISCHANGED(Property_City__c), ISBLANK(Property_City__c)), AND(ISCHANGED(Property_State__c), ISBLANK(Property_State__c)), AND(ISCHANGED(Property_Zip__c), ISBLANK(Property_Zip__c)) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: City, State, and Zip are required for MDU and Business ROE opportunities. These fields cannot be left blank or cleared once set.
